title: St. John's Wort Extract LI 160 for the Treatment of Atypical Depression
brief_summary: The aim of tis study is to assess the efficacy and safety of Jarsin® 300 mg as an acute treatment in mild to moderate depression with atypical features.
raw_criteria:
Main Inclusion Criteria:

* Mild to moderate depression (ICD-10 F32.0, F32.1) with atypical features according to DSM-IV, lasting at least 3 months
* Female and male Caucasians aged 18 to 70 years
* At least one of HAMD-28 scale items 22-26 scores \>1
